description: This file defines an abstract base class 'TestClassBase' intended for unit testing within the PDFsharp project. It includes utility methods for creating PDFs, test context handling, and file management specific to testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestClassBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility functions and setup for unit tests involving PDF generation and processing.

classes.name: TestInstance
classes.description: A nested singleton class managing test timings, directories, and font resolver for the testing framework.

methods.name: CreateNewPdfDocument
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new PDF document with basic metadata.

methods.name: CreatePdfPage
methods.description: Adds a new page to a PDF document with specified dimensions.

methods.name: TestSnippet
methods.description: Renders a code snippet into PDF and PNG formats, and optionally opens the directory.

methods.name: GetTestDocumentPath
methods.description: Generates a full file path within the test documents directory.

methods.name: SaveTestDocument
methods.description: Saves a PDF document to a specified filepath.

methods.name: SaveAndShowDocument
methods.description: Saves a PDF document and optionally opens it in a viewer.

methods.name: ConcatPdfFiles
methods.description: Concatenates multiple PDF files into one document.

methods.name: AddCurrentFilepath
methods.description: Tracks a file path for result aggregation and testing.

methods.name: GetAndRemoveFirstCurrentFilePath
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the oldest tracked file path.
